morceaux.1: P. OVIDI NASONIS EPISTVLAE HEROIDVM X. Ariadne Theseo Illa relicta feris etiam nunc, improbe Theseu vivit. Et haec aequa mente tulisse velis? Mitius inveni quam te genus omne ferarum; credita non ulli quam tibi peius eram.
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">quae legis, ex illo, <persName>Theseu</persName>, tibi litore mitto</l>
  <l n="2">unde tuam sine me vela tulere ratem,</l>
  <l n="3">in quo me somnusque meus male prodidit et tu,</l>
  <l n="4">per facinus somnis insidiate meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Tempus erat, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">vitrea</name> quo primum terra <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pruina</name></l>
  <l n="6">spargitur et tectae fronde queruntur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aves</name>;</l>
  <l n="7">incertum vigilans ac somno languida movi</l>
  <l n="8"><persName>Thesea</persName> prensuras semisupina manus:</l>
  <l n="9">nullus erat. referoque manus iterumque retempto</l>
  <l n="10">perque torum moveo bracchia: nullus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">excussere metus somnum; conterrita surgo</l>
  <l n="12">membraque sunt viduo praecipitata toro.</l>
  <l n="13">protinus adductis sonuerunt pectora palmis</l>
  <l n="14">utque erat e somno turbida, rupta <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">coma</name> est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15"><name type="deity">Luna</name> fuit; specto siquid nisi <placeName>litora</placeName> cernam;</l>
  <l n="16">quod videant oculi, nil nisi litus habent.</l>
  <l n="17">nunc huc, nunc illuc et utroque sine ordine, curro,</l>
  <l n="18">alta puellares tardat <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">harena</name> pedes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">interea toto clamanti litore "<persName>Theseu</persName>!"</l>
  <l n="20">reddebant nomen concava saxa tuum</l>
  <l n="21">et quotiens ego te, totiens locus ipse vocabat;</l>
  <l n="22">ipse locus miserae ferre volebat opem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23"><placeName>Mons</placeName> fuit; apparent <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">frutices</name> in vertice rari;</l>
  <l n="24">hinc scopulus raucis pendet adesus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquis</name>.</l>
  <l n="25">adscendo; vires animus dabat; atque ita late</l>
  <l n="26">aequora prospectu metior alta meo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">inde ego—nam ventis quoque sum crudelibus usa—</l>
  <l n="28">vidi praecipiti <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">carbasa</name> tenta <name type="deity">Notus</name>.</l>
  <l n="29">aut vidi aut fuerant quae me vidisse putarem;</l>
  <l n="30">frigidior <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">glacie</name> semianimisque fui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">nec languere diu patitur dolor. excitor illo,</l>
  <l n="32">excitor et summa <persName>Thesea</persName> voce voco.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">"quo fugis?" exclamo "scelerate revertere <persName>Theseu</persName>!</l>
  <l n="34">flecte ratem! numerum non habet illa suum!"</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Haec ego. quod voci deerat, plangore replebam;</l>
  <l n="2">  verbera cum verbis mixta fuere meis.</l>
  <l n="3">si non audires, ut saltem cernere posses:</l>
  <l n="4">  iactatae late signa dedere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">manus</name>.</l>
  <l n="5">candidaque imposui longae velamina <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">virgae</name></l>
  <l n="6">  scilicet oblitos admonitura mei.</l>
  <l n="7">iamque oculis ereptus eras. tum denique flevi;</l>
  <l n="8">  torpuerant molles ante dolore genae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">quid potius facerent, quam me mea <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lumina</name> flerent,</l>
  <l n="10">  postquam desieram vela videre tua?</l>
  <l n="11">aut ego diffusis erravi sola capillis,</l>
  <l n="12">  <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">qualis</name> ab Ogygio concita <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Baccha</name> deo;</l>
  <l n="13">aut <name type="placeName">mare</name> prospiciens in saxo frigida sedi,</l>
  <l n="14">  quamque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lapis</name> sedes, tam <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lapis</name> ipsa fui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">saepe torum repeto qui nos acceperat ambos,</l>
  <l n="16">  sed non acceptos exhibiturus erat</l>
  <l n="17">et tua quae possum pro te vestigia tango</l>
  <l n="18">  strataque quae membris intepuere tuis.</l>
  <l n="19">incumbo lacrimisque toro manante profusis</l>
  <l n="20">  "<quote>pressimus</quote>" exclamo "te duo, redde duos!</l>
  <l n="21">venimus huc ambo; cur non discedimus ambo?</l>
  <l n="22">  perfide, pars nostri, <name type="placeName">lectule</name>, maior ubi est?"</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">Quid faciam? quo sola ferar? vacat insula cultu;</l>
  <l n="24">  non hominum video, non ego facta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">boum</name>.</l>
  <l n="25">omne latus terrae cingit <name type="placeName">mare</name>; <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">navita</name> nusquam.</l>
  <l n="26">  nulla per ambiguas puppis itura vias.</l>
  <l n="27">finge dari comitesque mihi ventosque ratemque,</l>
  <l n="28">  quid sequar? accessus terra paterna negat.</l>
  <l n="29">ut rate felici pacata per aequora labar,</l>
  <l n="30">  temperet ut ventos <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Aeolus</name>; exul ero.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">non ego te, <name type="placeName">Crete</name>, centum digesta per urbes,</l>
  <l n="32">  adspiciam, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">puero</name> cognita terra <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovi</name>.</l>
  <l n="33">at pater et tellus iusto regnata parenti</l>
  <l n="34">  prodita sunt facto, nomina cara, meo,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">cum tibi, ne victor tecto morerere recurvo,</l>
  <l n="2">quae regerent passus, pro duce fila dedi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="3">tum mihi dicebas: "per ego ipsa pericula iuro</l>
  <l n="4">te fore, dum nostrum vivet uterque, meam."</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Vivimus, et non sum, Theseu, tua, si modo vivis,</l>
  <l n="6">femina periuri fraude sepulta viri.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">me quoque, qua fratrem mactasses, improbe, clava!</l>
  <l n="8">esset, quam dederas, morte soluta fides.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">nunc ego non tantum, quae sum passura, recordor,</l>
  <l n="10">sed quaecumque potest ulla relicta pati.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">occurrunt animo pereundi mille figurae,</l>
  <l n="12">morsque minus poenae quam mora mortis habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">iam iam venturos aut hac aut suspicor illac,</l>
  <l n="14">qui lanient <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">avido</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">dente</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupos</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">forsitan et fulvos tellus alat ista <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leones</name>?</l>
  <l n="16">quis scit an et saevas <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">tigridas</name> insula habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">et freta dicuntur magnas expellere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">phocas</name>;</l>
  <l n="18">quis vetat et gladios per latus ire meum?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">Tantum ne religer dura captiva catena,</l>
  <l n="20">neve traham serva grandia pensa manu,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">cui pater est <persName>Minos</persName>, cui mater filia <name type="deity">Phoebi</name>,</l>
  <l n="22">quodque magis memini, quae tibi pacta fui!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">si mare, si terras porrectaque litora vidi,</l>
  <l n="24">multa mihi terrae, multa minantur aquae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">caelum restabat; timeo simulacra deorum;</l>
  <l n="26">destituor rapidis praeda cibusque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feris</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">sive colunt habitantque viri, diffidimus illis;</l>
  <l n="28">externos didici laesa timere viros.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">Viveret <persName>Androgeos</persName> utinam, nec facta luisses</l>
  <l n="30">impia funeribus, <placeName>Cecropi</placeName> terra, tuis;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">nec tua mactasset nodoso stipite, <persName>Theseu</persName>,</l>
  <l n="32">ardua parte virum dextera, parte <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bovem</name>;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">nec tibi, quae reditus monstrarent, fila dedissem,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">fila per adductas saepe recepta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">manus</name>.</l>
  <l n="2">non equidem miror, si stat victoria tecum</l>
  <l n="3">strataque <placeName>Cretaeam</placeName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">belua</name> planxit humum.</l>
  <l n="4">non poterant figi praecordia ferrea cornu;</l>
  <l n="5">ut te non tegeres, pectore tutus eras.</l>
  <l n="6">illic tu silices, illic adamanta tulisti,</l>
  <l n="7">illic, qui silices, <persName>Thesea</persName>, vincat, habes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">Crudeles somni, quid me tenuistis inertem?</l>
  <l n="9">aut semel aeterna nocte premenda fui.</l>
  <l n="10">vos quoque crudeles venti, nimiumque parati</l>
  <l n="11">flaminaque in lacrimas officiosa meas;</l>
  <l n="12">dextera crudelis, quae me fratremque necavit,</l>
  <l n="13">et data poscenti, nomen inane, fides:</l>
  <l n="14">in me iurarunt somnus ventusque fidesque:</l>
  <l n="15">prodita sum causis una puella tribus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="16">Ergo ego nec lacrimas matris moritura videbo</l>
  <l n="17">nec mea qui digitis lumina condat, erit.</l>
  <l n="18">spiritus infelix peregrinas ibit in auras</l>
  <l n="19">nec positos artus unguet amica manus.</l>
  <l n="20">ossa superstabunt volucres inhumata marinae;</l>
  <l n="21">haec sunt officiis digna sepulcra meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="22">ibis <placeName>Cecropios</placeName> portus patriaque receptus,</l>
  <l n="23">cum steteris urbis celsus in arce tuae</l>
  <l n="24">et bene narraris letum taurique virique</l>
  <l n="25">sectaque per dubias saxea tecta vias;</l>
  <l n="26">me quoque narrato sola tellure relictam;</l>
  <l n="27">non ego sum titulis subripienda tuis!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="28">nec pater est <persName>Aegeus</persName>, nec tu <persName>Pittheidos</persName> <persName>Aethrae</persName></l>
  <l n="29">filius; auctores saxa fretumque tui.</l>
  <l n="30">Di facerent ut me summa de puppe videres,</l>
  <l n="31">movisset vultus maesta figura tuos.</l>
  <l n="32">nunc quoque non oculis, sed qua potes, adspice mente</l>
  <l n="33">haerentem scopulo quem vaga pulsat aqua;</l>
  <l n="34">adspice demissos lugentis more capillos</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">et tunicas lacrimis sicut ab imbre <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">graves</name>!</l>
  <l n="2">corpus ut impulsae segetes <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquilonibus</name> horret</l>
  <l n="3">litteraque articulo pressa tremente labat.</l>
  <l n="4">non te per meritum, quoniam male cessit, adoro;</l>
  <l n="5">debita sit facto gratia nulla meo.</l>
  <l n="6">sed ne poena quidem. si non ego causa salutis,</l>
  <l n="7">non tamen est cur sis tu mihi causa necis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">Has tibi plangendo lugubria pectora lassas</l>
  <l n="9">infelix tendo trans freta lata manus;</l>
  <l n="10">hos tibi qui superant ostendo maesta capillos;</l>
  <l n="11">per lacrimas oro, quas tua facta movent:</l>
  <l n="12">flecte ratem, <persName>Theseu</persName>, versoque relabere vento;</l>
  <l n="13">si prius occidero, tu tamen ossa feres.</l>
</lg>
